findings.claim: Contract §7 says admit and reject use 'bodies do contrato gerado' and that reject sends reason plus a server-required legalBasis. TASK-0027.md:20 requires generated types with no casts. But the current commands contract declares no requestBody, path parameter, If-Match or Idempotency-Key header and no ETag response for raitCaseAdmit or raitCaseNonAdmission (docs/framework/contracts/BP-INF-RAIT-CASE-001.commands.openapi.json; packages/api-clients/src/generated/BP-INF-RAIT-CASE-001.commands.ts:279 and :297 have 'requestBody?: never'). TASK-0024.md:6-8 only adds F01 and createRaitAdmissibility, so the frontend would have to write a manual DTO or a cast. That breaks contract lines 31-32.
findings.fix: Add to TASK-0024 and the contract: handwritten OpenAPI requestBody schemas for raitCaseAdmit (strict {}) and raitCaseNonAdmission ({reason, legalBasis}, both required). Declare the If-Match/Idempotency-Key header parameters and the {data,events} response with an ETag header for raitCaseTriage, createRaitAdmissibility, raitCaseAdmit and raitCaseNonAdmission. Then regenerate the clients so TASK-0027 can type every call from the contract.

findings.claim: Reject semantics are ambiguous across layers. The server reads payload.reason as one of the codes intempestivo, ilegitimo, sem_assinatura or pedido_incompativel and maps it to the criterion that must be false (backend/domains/inf/rait-case/src/handwritten/rait-case-command.service.ts:1263-1270). It requires the fields reason and legalBasis (same file :82). The current client sends non_admission_reason (apps/rait/web/src/app/data/api/case.client.ts:247). The form has nonAdmissionReason and nonAdmissionGrounds (apps/rait/web/src/app/forms/triagem.schema.ts:49-50). The contract only says 'reason e legalBasis', without saying reason is the art. 4 code or that legalBasis is the operator's grounds text. That leaves a hidden semantic mapping for Inspector and Frontend.
findings.fix: State in the contract that reason = nonAdmissionReason (the NON_ADMISSION_REASONS code, checked by the server against the false criterion) and legalBasis = nonAdmissionGrounds (operator text, no legal mapping on the client). Retire the non_admission_reason field from the client signature. TASK-0025 and TASK-0027 should cite this mapping.

findings.claim: The client API for F-01 versus saving the checklist is not fixed. The existing CaseClient.triage(caseId, CreateRaitAdmissibilityDto[], ifMatch) is shaped like a batch checklist save (apps/rait/web/src/app/data/api/case.client.ts:225-232), and its M8 row calls it with an array (case.client.spec.ts:204-207). The contract leaves the new checklist method conditional ('Se houver novo método', lines 84-85 and 98-99). Yet TASK-0025 (Inspector) writes the M8 substitutions, wiring specs and the preview inventory 'checklist novo' (TASK-0025.md:22-27) before TASK-0027 decides names and signatures. The sensors cannot be executed without guessing the API.
findings.fix: Fix in the contract, before TASK-0025: the method name and signature for F-01 (for example, triage repurposed to an empty body with ifMatch and idempotency key), the method that saves one human criterion (name, input type derived from createRaitAdmissibility, ifMatch/key), the facade counterparts, the M8 keys each one maps to, and the corresponding entry in the preview inventory.

findings.claim: 'materialize somente ADR-0041 e contracts/JW01-admissibility.md' reads as if ADR-0041 still needs writing, but it already exists. The prompt also does not require the handwritten POST to keep @Resource('inf:rait-admissibility') + @Action('create') + @Audit INF_RAIT_ADMISSIBILITY_CREATE (backend/domains/inf/rait-case/src/controllers/rait-admissibility.controller.ts:16-30). Keeping those is what makes the existing policy (backend/domains/shared/src/policy.ts:1412) remain authoritative without a new key, as ADR-0041:32 says.
findings.fix: Reword to 'materializar conforme ADR-0041/contrato'. Record in the contract and in TASK-0026 that the handwritten admissibility controller reuses the existing resource/action/audit decorators and needs no new policy.ts key.

findings.claim: acceptance_commands are narrower than the prompt prose. TASK-0026.md:28-30 requires typecheck for inf-rait-case/app, contracts:check/test, blueprints:check and verify:decorators/role-catalog/rls-ddl, but they are missing from the JSON. TASK-0025.json:33-41 lists only two web specs and omits the facade/triage specs and the focused backend suites.
findings.fix: Align acceptance_commands with each prompt. Keep the DB suites marked blocked when there is no disposable database, never skipped.
